blocks.text: Ammonia nitrogen ka aham sanati compound hai, jo zyada tar fertiliser ke taur par istemal hoti hai. Yeh sanati taur par Haber-Bosch process se banai jati hai: N2(g) + 3H2(g) 2NH3(g) ke saath equilibrium mein. Agle teen topics us ki basicity, ammonium ion ki banawat aur ammonium salts se us ki laboratory tayyari bayan karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ammonia itne bare paimane par kyun banai jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Us ka zyada tar hissa fertilisers mein jata hai, seedha ya ammonium salts aur urea ke taur par, kyunke paudon ko fixed nitrogen chahiye aur woh hawa ki nitrogen istemal nahi kar sakte; Haber-Bosch process is maqsad ke liye fiza ki nitrogen aur hydrogen ko ammonia mein badalta hai.

items: NH3: sanati nitrogen compound, zyada tar fertiliser; Haber-Bosch process N2 + 3H2 = 2NH3 se bani.
